If you are interested in ML work and don't know where to start I recommend this guys channel. His videos are a good length for me where they cover the breadth of a topic well and get me interested in parts of ML training I don't think about while giving good intro info to start. Highly recommend!
He does a heavy focus on RL since that's his speciality but imo I think RL is a good way of viewing ML problems since the general solution pipeline can be comparable to other ML processes

entries.note:
World models are the future and LeCunn in this paper basically stated how they are going to function moving forward imo
LLMs predict by the following token which might be limited in scale, World Models predict a latent world state and take a course of action into the future predicatively which opens up a new world for computer understanding. This paper just talked about how to make that world state better with the idea of a “disruption” layer needs to be coupled so the model can learn more effectively from events that are not in its training set and prevents fit for the most convenient answer. IMO, this will be an architecture that will change how we interact with every day life and its important to understand it so you can learn to apply it to other things.
entries.title: Counterfactual World Models:JEPAs That Reason About “What If”
